declaration.reason: Owner-authorised 25 November 2026 policy correction: EVERYONE IN IRPA MUST HAVE FULL MEETING PORTAL ACCESS. Every IRPA member/employee identity may access the complete Meeting Portal and initiate/register meetings regardless of membership/employment status, category, department, title, organisational authority, invitation or participant listing. External invitees remain limited to the meeting to which they are invited. Meeting-specific leadership, live-room admission, Board voting/quorum, protected Board records, audit and deletion controls remain separate and unchanged.
declaration.expectedEffect: Universal full Meeting Portal access for every IRPA identity across all categories, records, working documents and archives, with unrestricted meeting initiation/registration by an IRPA identity. No active-status, department, role, organisational-authority, invitation or participant-list gate may restrict ordinary portal access. External invitees receive only invited-meeting access. The meeting-specific Chairperson, Secretary and Administrator appointments and their distinct authorities remain in force; registration-stage appointments may be empty but all three are required before proceedings; Transition Committee authority expires at proceedings start. Board voting, quorum, resolutions, formal approvals, restricted Board records, audit protections, minimum ten-year retention and trial-only deletion remain protected.
prohibitedChanges: Do not create portal-wide meeting leadership roles.
Do not allow Meeting Administrator to chair, vote, establish quorum, approve resolutions or approve minutes by virtue of that role.
Do not retain Transition Committee authority after formal proceedings begin.
Do not allow appointments or permissions to leak between concurrent meetings.
Do not weaken Board quorum, ordinary governance voting, signature, legal-hold, retention, audit or protected deletion safeguards.
Do not change unrelated Firestore collections or other portal permissions.
